zh.focusStrategy: 发现值得解决的问题，做出产品决策，并明确如何评估结果。
zh.focusInteraction: 通过清晰、自然的交互，让人们更好地理解和使用 AI。

type.zh: 团队项目 · AI Agent 原型

summary.en: Turning wearable signals and calendar context into timely, conversational guidance.
summary.zh: 将可穿戴信号与日程结合，通过对话提供及时的建议。

body.en: Pison Ultimate Agent turns Pison Watch data into contextual conversations. My role covered product and agent design.
body.zh: Pison Ultimate Agent 将 Pison Watch 数据转化为有上下文的对话。我负责产品与 Agent 设计。

focus.zh: Agent 行为 · 情境化建议

summary.en: Turning creator needs into AI-powered marketing workflows.
summary.zh: 将创作者需求转化为 AI 营销工作流。

body.en: At Qwen, I worked on the development and international launch of Qwen Create, an AI-agent product for end-to-end marketing workflows.
body.zh: 在千问，我参与 Qwen Create 从开发到海外上线的过程，将创作者需求转化为端到端的 AI 营销工作流。

contribution.en: My work included defining a multi-agent product architecture and evaluation across model quality, planning, execution, and end-to-end task success.
contribution.zh: 我的工作包括定义多 Agent 产品架构，以及围绕模型质量、规划、执行和端到端任务完成度建立评测。

focus.zh: 多 Agent 工作流 · 评测

summary.en: A webcam tool I built to collect gaze estimates during portfolio reviews.
summary.zh: 我为作品集评审开发的摄像头眼动采集工具。

body.en: A reader calibrates the webcam, opens a PDF and reads at their own pace. I can then review and export a heatmap for each page.
body.zh: 读者校准摄像头、打开 PDF，按自己的节奏翻页。我可以在阅读结束后查看并导出每一页的热图。

focus.zh: 眼动追踪 · 交互实验

body.en: An experimental architecture intervention in development.
body.zh: 一个正在进行中的建筑干预实验项目。

summary.en: An SDXL adapter trained on a personal selection of Lucian Freud works, tested on portraits, contemporary scenes and still lifes.
summary.zh: 基于个人筛选的弗洛伊德作品训练 SDXL 适配器，并以肖像、当代场景与静物检验其表现。

body.en: The private study compares a selected 750-step checkpoint against matched controls across 12 subjects and two seeds.
body.zh: 本地研究选用第 750 步的检查点，在 12 组主体描述和两个随机种子上进行对照。

focus.zh: LoRA · 模型微调 · 图像生成

type.zh: 独立项目 · 产品与服务

summary.en: Making campus equipment easier to share.
summary.zh: 让校园设备共享更便捷。

body.en: Co-Hive is a hardware-software campus sharing platform developed with Brown University and RISD. It connects smart lockers, real-time device synchronization, and a consumer borrowing experience.
body.zh: Co-Hive 是与布朗大学和 RISD 合作开发的校园共享平台，将智能储物柜、实时设备同步与用户借还体验连接起来。

contribution.en: I led product development from user research to launch, using usability testing and behavioral data to improve the scan, borrow, return, and rewards journey.
contribution.zh: 我负责从用户研究到上线的产品开发，通过可用性测试与行为数据改进扫码、借用、归还和奖励流程。

focus.zh: 用户研究 · 产品与服务设计
